SELECT "part"."p_container", "supplier"."s_acctbal", AVG("part"."p_retailprice")
FROM "supplier" JOIN "partsupp" ON "supplier"."s_suppkey" = "partsupp"."ps_suppkey" LEFT JOIN "part" ON "partsupp"."ps_partkey" = "part"."p_partkey" WHERE "partsupp"."ps_availqty" > 2286 AND "partsupp"."ps_suppkey" = 3947 GROUP BY "part"."p_container", "supplier"."s_acctbal" ORDER BY "part"."p_container" DESC, AVG("part"."p_retailprice") DESC
